field.label: Enable
field.help: Watch the selected interfaces and record per-device traffic.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: The LAN or VLAN interfaces your devices are on. Only interfaces with their own address and no gateway are listed (not WAN, not a bridge's member ports); with a bridge, choose the bridge.

field.label: Keep sites seen (days)
field.help: Site names each device used (from DNS answers and TLS and QUIC connections), kept to name its traffic and identify it.
